understood_as: New standalone optical layout and beam raster candidates only; identical semantic artifacts and owner evidence. GT16B stays immutable. No new source interpretation, horizontal movement, octave change or production work.
selection: Select6px heuristic first, never choose target from visual results. Evaluate10/14 as labeled alternatives. All112 lyric/continuation bitmap components move by one minimal nonnegative integer dy per system; both rows/marks coupled. Fixed x, glyph alpha, ordering and row spacing. Evaluate full finite domain in existing allocations; if infeasible evaluate 120px additional allocation per system and translate entire systems losslessly by cumulative increments, without changing local music geometry. Enlarged diagnostic canvas allowed, no implicit original-page fidelity claim.
hard_safety: All nonzero alpha counts: zero lyric/music, lyric/lyric and cross-system contacts; unchanged notes/chords/lyrics/ties/repeat signatures; anchor<=0.5px. Optical goal does not replace hard checks. Actual pixel-edge distance uses axis-aligned closed unit pixel squares, not centroid distance or conservative proxy alone.
baseline_reconstruction: Use GT14E load_components for frozen first/second text and GT15B/GT16B text placements for third/fourth. Reconstruct112=84syllables+28marks and their exact union. Separate generated fixed notation only after verifying disjointness and lossless recomposition. No source raster segmentation or mask modification.
beam_scope: Only diagonal, single-level eighth beam groups in systems3/4 with frozen individual masks and persisted line/endpoints/stem memberships. Keep mixed beams/hooks in systems1/2 and all horizontal beams unchanged; explicitly report residual stair-steps. No ties/heads/stems/flags moved or rerasterized.
beam_candidates: 2x/3x/4x fixed subpixel-area sampling with BOX averaging, no ringing or nonzero-alpha threshold. Sample subpixel centers on page pixel-center grid. Vertical strip width equals persisted thickness and centerline equals frozen line; x cap edges half a pixel beyond frozen endpoint centers retain endpoint column coverage. No endpoint retuning. Compare full nonzero-alpha support, attachments, geometric profiles and unrelated contacts. Select highest4x if safe and detrended coverage-centroid RMS improves over old; otherwise3x then2x, otherwise retain frozen beam with explicit failure. Geometry remains fixed, bitmap byte equality intentionally not required.
beam_recomposition: Reconstruct exact third music/context union using existing source-context scaffold/header/ending functions and frozen music components, then replace only selected beam masks. Fourth context already frozen individually. Restore every nonbeam component and prove equality before substitution; no subtractive inference of original source ink.
metrics: Per priority measure and system: center and exact pixel-square edge clearance, nearest pixel pairs and matching actual notation component IDs where available, component boxes, available integer vertical domain, shifts, contact/clipping checks. Beam per-column alpha-weighted coverage-centroid error and detrended error, intermediate-alpha pixels, nonzero and coverage area, connected components, stem contacts. Report native and50percent-display agent inspection separately from independent musician review (none unless actual submission).
controls: Synthetic integer/fractional placements and positive/negative slopes; horizontal controls; explicit broken-attachment, unrelated-contact, clipping and infeasible-layout controls; deterministic repeat. Freeze design before real candidate generation.
preservation: Hash every loaded historical directory and all GT16B prediction/metadata/owner-bound files before and after. Read only Bb source graph and existing semantics, no target reference access. Serialize diagnostic copies only, full unchanged V3 guards plus event/chord/lyric/repeat signatures. Extender MusicXML gap,10SIG exclusions and withheld playback unchanged.
stopping: Freeze candidate PNG/mask hashes before agent visual inspection. Outcome is an incomplete research preview, not professional engraving or independently verified accuracy. No retuning after inspection. No merge/deploy/Full Acceptance.
